title: Guided observability starter frames — mini tutorial sequence for latency, cost-per-token, and trace views
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Design a compact, guided screenshot sequence and annotated assets for the Observability quickstart that walks new users through three micro-scenarios: per-route latency analysis, cost-per-token breakdown, and an end-to-end trace waterfall. Deliverables include layered Figma frames for web and compact mobile, annotated copy for in-product overlays, export-ready PNG/JPEG assets for docs and release notes, and a short micro-tutorial script for the product tour team.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 9 export-ready frames: 3 latency frames (overview, outlier drill, compare routes), 3 cost frames (token breakdown, aggregate cost sparklines, per-call breakdown), 3 trace frames (waterfall zoomed, KV cache hit example, fallback routing event).
Each frame has pixel-accurate annotations and owner-approved microcopy, reviewed in Figma and pinned in a single comment thread.
Mobile-compact variants created for the most-used 3 frames with responsive spacing and legible microcopy at 360px width.
All assets exported to the release folder with 2x and 3x PNGs and one SVG for the cost sparkline; filenames follow the release naming convention.
Micro-tutorial script (approx 3 steps) written and handed off to Product Marketing and Console engineers with links to the frames and the storyboard PR.
Design review sign-off from PM and Eng and a linked PR to the docs repo created with at least one iteration responding to comments.
design_notes: Prioritize digestible first-impression: first frame must convey latency and cost at-a-glance using combined sparkline + summary card.
Keep highlight color palette consistent with Console theme; use amber for cost anomalies and purple for latency outliers to avoid overlap with existing red/green error states.
Trace waterfall should call out user-visible events (model fallback, KV cache miss) with callouts that reference timeline ticks rather than absolute ms to avoid misleading decimals.
Include an optional ghost overlay layer for engineers to toggle trace layer granularities in Figma for future animation handoff.
